README: Music and effects are cued to the aligned narration. Sampled effects come from Topics/SoundEffects and are hashed in sound.lock.json.

sections.why: Open with a question and an empty score: curious, not melodramatic.
The format and alternating versions are clear factual setup.
The score tightens and the final rounds approach.
The pre-agreed split reframes the prize and lowers the pressure.

sfx.name: sampled-air-swish
sfx.why: A soft sampled air pass introduces the two sides of the arena.
The physical prize board appears on the word prize.
A restrained count begins under the amount.

sfx.name: sampled-flight-swish
sfx.why: Sampled whoosh for the camera's continuous reveal of the full arena.
Ten physical round pavers come into view.
A quiet metallic accent for the tournament board.
The first version marker settles onto its pedestal.

sfx.name: sampled-marker-pop
sfx.why: Sampled pop for the 1.8 marker, used consistently for physical markers.

sfx.name: sampled-boundary-flight
sfx.why: A sampled air swish follows the camera across the center seam.
The dividing seam lands as neither player gets home turf.
The drawn coin begins its toss.

sfx.name: sampled-ding
sfx.why: A restrained sampled confirmation when the coin selects the opener.
The displayed combat advantage changes sides.

sfx.name: sampled-version-flight
sfx.why: A short sample tracks the camera's orbit across the two version markers.
A small count movement illustrates a changing lead, not match footage.
The style marker changes once more.

sfx.name: sampled-flight-to-opening
sfx.why: Sampled camera-flight sound into the opening exchange.
A muted stylized contact accents the first point, without suggesting exact footage audio.

sfx.name: sampled-score-ding
sfx.why: The score gets one small sampled confirmation.
A second restrained stylized exchange beat.
A soft counterpoint to the level score.

sfx.name: sampled-rule-flight
sfx.why: Sampled swish as the lens moves from duel to the ten-round rule board.
The six-win threshold illuminates.
A quiet marker lands on the physical ten-round track.
Three even score beats, kept light under the line.

sfx.name: sampled-score-marker
sfx.why: Sampled pop as the score marker changes.
Two close, even score beats.
A single quiet pulse for the remaining rounds.
A short restrained rise toward match point.

sfx.name: sampled-match-point-ding
sfx.why: A small sampled score marker, not a crowd reaction.
The alternate path moves across the board.
A low, brief falling accent for the hypothetical path only.
A brief pause immediately before the result.
The verified final score sets into the physical board.

sfx.name: sampled-final-score-ding
sfx.why: The same sampled ding marks the decisive score.
Very soft shimmer on the finished score, not a celebration crowd.

sfx.name: sampled-prize-flight
sfx.why: Sampled swish as the prize enters the composition.
A small coin texture accompanies the single chest, before the reveal of the agreement.

sfx.name: sampled-cash-chime
sfx.why: A low sampled cash-register accent for the prize mention.
The chest lid begins to open on the pre-game agreement.
The single prize separates into equal halves.

sfx.name: sampled-share-pop
sfx.why: Two physical shares are clearly established.
The pressure eases when the advance agreement is explained.

sfx.name: sampled-soft-ta-da
sfx.why: A quiet, short sample accompanies the lighter explanation, not the victory.
Confirm the winner without implying an audience reaction.
The imagined unequal share falls away.

sfx.name: sampled-return-flight
sfx.why: A sampled whoosh returns to the opening arena tableau.

sfx.name: sampled-equal-share-chime
sfx.why: A quiet cash chime under the equal chests, the same source as the first prize accent.
A compact count resolves the ten rounds.
The prize is shared, not handed over as a surprise.

sfx.name: sampled-final-pullback
sfx.why: A final sampled air pass accompanies the quiet pullback.
The settled pre-game agreement is underscored once.

sfx.name: sampled-end-ding
sfx.why: A familiar, small sampled ding closes the final subscribe cue.
